findings.title: Change claims map known authorization failures to the wrong disposition
findings.reproduction: Evaluate unsupported-control, unauthorized-noncanonical, and terminal-control change claims.
findings.closure: Every dependent draft-v1 authorization failure is invalid, authorization precedes lineage, and signed Rust and opaque independent parity proofs agree.

findings.title: Control parent and base-frontier relationships lack reasoned resolution
findings.reproduction: Evaluate children under each parent and base-head evidence state, then extend pending, invalid, and noncanonical branches.
findings.closure: Exhaustive reason states survive indexing and evaluation, descendants propagate deterministically, and noncanonical branches are statefully validated before exclusion.

findings.title: Checkpoint chunks lack complete descriptor-reference resolution
findings.reproduction: Evaluate target chunks referencing missing, pending, wrong-kind, wrong-coordinate, invalid, unsupported, and dynamically unusable descriptor evidence.
findings.closure: One exhaustive resolver assigns every target chunk exactly one disposition and permits promotion only after genuinely missing evidence arrives.

findings.title: Evaluation and finalization contain unmetered target-proportional work
findings.reproduction: Exercise zero-budget, cancellation, large duplicate-claim, interrupted-finalization, and exact-boundary evaluations.
findings.closure: Views borrow indexes, prior knowledge is metered and cancellable, finalization has zero unexplained remainder, and invariants run under capacity.

findings.title: The signed corpus omits material combined and reference-state scenarios
findings.reproduction: Compare the 124-scenario v6 manifest with the required mixed claim, relationship, checkpoint, and resource scenario inventory.
findings.closure: Signed distribution v7 contains exactly 157 scenarios and both implementations emit byte-identical outputs across required orders and repeated runs.

findings.title: Requirement evidence is not semantically fail-closed
findings.reproduction: Replace consensus-critical exact proof identifiers with broad workspace commands or profile-only overlays.
findings.closure: Every applicable in-core row binds exact executed proof, generic proof is rejected, and opaque parity evidence names exact fixture IDs and profile hashes.

findings.title: The externally authored NIP remains non-self-contained
findings.reproduction: Compare the read-only NIP with interoperability-critical companion rules.
findings.closure: Local companion authority and a portable external reconciliation delta are complete; the finding remains held until separately authored NIP prose is supplied and reconciled.

findings.title: External assurance and publication gates remain open
findings.reproduction: Inspect external holds and the absence of separately granted remote or publication authority.
findings.closure: All local implementation gates pass while sustained fuzzing, independent review, NIP reconciliation, and every remote or publication action remain explicit holds.
